description.summary: macOS Tahoe 26 Window Chrome, Liquid Glass and Aqua Experience

protocol.description: This protocol defines compositor extensions for macOS Tahoe 26 window semantics: - Unified Liquid Glass and G2 Superellipse (Squircle) rendering parameters. - Floating Glass Pills for sidebars and toolbars with custom inset margins. - Traffic light control (Close, Minimize, Zoom/Tile) with dirty state dot. - Document proxy icons with drag-and-drop file path binding. - Modal sheets attached to parent window titlebars. - Universal window tabbing and tab detach/reattach mechanics.

interface.name: zquartz_shell_v1

description.summary: Factory interface for Quartz window extensions

interface.description: The global interface exposed by the Quartz compositor to create per-surface and per-window decoration controllers.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: Destroy the global shell manager

request.description: Destroys the factory object. Existing objects created from this interface remain unaffected.

request.name: get_quartz_surface

description.summary: Obtain Quartz surface controller for a given surface

request.description: Instantiates a zquartz_surface_v1 object associated with an existing wl_surface to manage Tahoe 26 chrome, liquid glass effects, traffic lights and proxy icon interactions.

request.name: create_sheet

description.summary: Create a modal sheet attached to a parent surface

request.description: Creates a modal sheet dialog attached to the parent window's titlebar. The sheet moves synchronously with the parent and blocks input exclusively to the parent window.

request.name: create_tab_group

description.summary: Create a native window tab group

request.description: Groups multiple windows into a native tab bar.

arg.name: group_id
arg.summary: Unique identifier or application bundle id for the tab group

interface.name: zquartz_surface_v1

description.summary: Quartz window chrome and Liquid Glass controller

interface.description: Manages client-compositor coordination for macOS Tahoe 26 styling: traffic lights, dirty state, proxy icons, floating glass sidebars, and window tiling popovers.

description.summary: Individual traffic light identifiers

entry.name: close
entry.summary: Red button (Close window or Option+Close all)

entry.name: minimize
entry.summary: Yellow button (Minimize with Genie effect or Option+Minimize all)

entry.name: zoom
entry.summary: Green button (Full screen, Option+Classic Zoom, or Tiling popover)

description.summary: Visual state of the traffic lights cluster

entry.name: hovered
entry.summary: Hovering over cluster: reveals symbols x, -, +

description.summary: Window tiling presets from green button popover

entry.name: classic_zoom
entry.summary: Maximize to desktop work area preserving dock and menu bar

entry.name: tile_left_half
entry.summary: Tile to left 50% screen with 8px margin

entry.name: tile_right_half
entry.summary: Tile to right 50% screen with 8px margin

description.summary: Destroy Quartz surface controller

request.name: set_document_edited

description.summary: Toggle edited (dirty) indicator in red close button

request.description: When set to true, the red close button displays an inner dark dot indicating unsaved document changes.

request.name: set_proxy_icon_file

description.summary: Bind document file path to titlebar proxy icon

request.description: Provides the canonical URI or filesystem path of the active document. The compositor renders the file proxy icon next to the title text and enables dragging the proxy icon to initiate a wl_data_device drag of the file.

arg.name: file_path
arg.summary: Absolute filesystem path or file:// URI

request.name: set_liquid_glass_region

description.summary: Define region for liquid glass refractive shader

request.description: Specifies a region within the surface where the background dual-Kawase blur, G2 squircle SDF, chromatic dispersion and specular rim must be composited.

request.name: create_floating_pill

description.summary: Register a floating glass pill within this surface

request.description: Creates a floating glass sidebar or toolbar pill that floats above the scrolling content with 8px inset margins and G2 squircle clipping.

event.name: traffic_light_clicked

description.summary: Notification that user clicked a traffic light button

event.description: Sent to the client when a traffic light button is clicked.

arg.name: modifiers
arg.summary: Active modifiers (1 = Shift, 2 = Option, 4 = Cmd, 8 = Ctrl)

event.name: traffic_light_state_changed

description.summary: Traffic lights cluster state update

event.description: Notifies client of hover or focus changes affecting traffic lights display.

event.name: tiling_action_requested

description.summary: User triggered a tiling action via green button popover

event.description: Sent when user selects an action in the 500ms hover tiling popover.

interface.name: zquartz_floating_pill_v1

description.summary: Floating Glass Pill controller for sidebars and toolbars

interface.description: Controls an isolated capsule floating over the window content with its own analytical dual-layer shadow, squircle G2 SDF outline, and refraction.

description.summary: Destroy floating pill controller

request.name: set_geometry

description.summary: Update pill dimensions and positioning

request.description: Updates the geometry and inset margins of the floating pill.

request.name: set_shadow_level

description.summary: Select shadow preset for pill

request.description: Sets shadow profile: 2 for standard floating glass pill (10px blur, 4px y-offset).

interface.name: zquartz_sheet_v1

description.summary: Modal Sheet dialog controller

interface.description: Manages a sheet dialog that slides out from beneath the parent window's titlebar with a spring animation and modal dimming overlay on the parent.

description.summary: Dismiss and destroy the sheet

request.name: present

description.summary: Animate sheet unfolding from parent titlebar

request.description: Triggers the 120fps spring animation unfolding the sheet downward.

request.name: dismiss

description.summary: Animate sheet folding back under parent titlebar

request.description: Reverses the spring animation, restoring full interactivity to the parent.

description.summary: Sheet has finished rollout animation
Sheet has finished folding animation and is closed

interface.name: zquartz_tab_group_v1

description.summary: Universal Window Tab Bar controller

interface.description: Allows multiple windows belonging to an application or workflow to be merged into a unified window frame with native macOS Tahoe 26 tabs.

description.summary: Destroy tab group controller

request.name: add_surface

description.summary: Add a surface to the tab group

request.description: Embeds the given surface as a tab in this group.

request.name: remove_surface

description.summary: Remove a surface from the tab group

request.description: Extracts a tab from the group, restoring it to a standalone window.

request.name: select_tab

description.summary: Switch active tab

request.description: Brings the tab at index to the front of the window frame.

event.name: tab_detached

description.summary: User dragged tab vertically beyond threshold (>32px)

event.description: Sent when the user drags a tab out of the tab bar, signaling that it should become a separate top-level window.

event.name: tab_reordered

description.summary: Tabs were reordered by user drag

event.description: Notifies client of tab position changes within the tab bar.
